title: CAKED UP!
description: A mod that adds more cakes and pies)
body:
Ever had the feeling that the game of Minecraft is lacking cake? This mod incorporates a set of new cakes into the game that have different recipes, all while maintaining a vanilla like style. Perfect for decorating builds, celebrating achievements, or just satisfying your hunger in a tastier way.

# Currently adds:

![Apple Pie Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c205d1878ab33d6e8b4127a3cbce97a77136eac6.png)

### Apple Pie, a direct alternative to a pumpkin pie but made with apples.

![Carrot Cake Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c79900f5d8366e20174b881fe56427db6c2fb51.png)

### Carrot Cake, a direct alternative to a normal cake but with carrots.


## New Recipe Item & Golden Apple Pie:

![golden recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9adeeb9d91be3b05f832bb3718a47a25a6b4dba.png)![golden apple pie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/341ccc4ec6590cdcc57a92760fe244014ce150d8.png)

### Find the new Golden Recipe found in the treasure room of a bastion and use it to upgrade a normal pie to a golden variant.


if there is enough attention i will update this mod and revamp the textures
